title: National Design Specification (NDS) for Wood Construction, 2018 Edition
use_for: Design provisions and equations, adjustment factors, member and connection rules (bolts, lag screws, nails, split ring and shear plate connectors, timber rivets), fire design, appendices A-N. The species/grade design-value tables are not here; they are in the Supplement.

text.file_pattern: pNNN.txt (NNN = pdf page, zero-padded to 3 digits)

title: NDS Supplement: Design Values for Wood Construction, 2018 Edition
use_for: Tabulated reference design values by species and grade (sawn lumber Tables 4A-4F, glued laminated timber 5A-5D, round timber piles and poles 6A-6B), section properties (Tables 1A-1D), lumber grading agencies, species combinations.

text.file_pattern: pNNN.txt (NNN = pdf page, zero-padded to 3 digits)
